reviewer.tool: claude -p (fresh session: no tools, no settings, empty folder)

notes: No item misstates the guide. Several conflicts between the type-derived facts, the guide and the evidence are worth a human check. (1) /configuration/8 and /facts/props/3 come from the package types. They say the default button renders only when buttonLabel or onPressButton is set, and that buttonSlot={null} removes it. The 7 Oct evidence says the opposite: buttonSlot={null} still renders the default "Button", and the buttonLabel default is "Button". The guide's doDont also says that without props a Nudge reads "Split payment" and "Button". This is probably the #206 change landing in a later install. If so, the guide's placeholder-copy Don't, /content/rules/4 and /content/bad "Button" may be stale. (2) /facts/props/1 gives the title default as "" from the component source, but the guide and the 7 Oct evidence give the default as "Split payment". The same #206 change may explain this, and it should be confirmed. (3) /content/good lists "Split payment", which the guide's doDont names as placeholder copy. It is also used deliberately with real body text in the guide's live examples, so it is not clearly wrong. It is still an ambiguous 'good' example. (4) The guide's Sources line says the card has no role or name on the web. The 13 Oct evidence, and /facts/props/1, say the root is now a region named by its title, so the guide copy is stale on that point.
